_comment: Game-rule and UI timing constants — not engine physics.

ui._comment: physics_tick_hz: physics integration frequency (sets dt_s = 1/hz). Higher = finer physics resolution, does NOT change game speed. default_sim_speed: match-seconds per real-second (1.0=real-time, 2.0=2x speed). steps_per_frame = round(physics_tick_hz * sim_speed / target_fps).
